$comment: Golden parity fixtures for MergeCaseInsensitive (uBaseUnit.pas:1438-1455) — TStringList(CaseSensitive=False, Duplicates=dupIgnore, Sorted=True), AddText per input (DoSetTextStr line split), Text out (LF-joined + trailing LF). Every 'expected' string was derived by hand-simulating the FPC 3.2.2 algorithm: sorted case-insensitive, dupIgnore drops the NEW line on a case-insensitive match (the FIRST-ADDED case variant survives), interior empty lines are items, a trailing break adds no item, LineEnding = LF (Linux runtime convention, engine/lua/tstrings.ts).

cases.name: empty-string inputs yield empty string (AddText adds no lines)
single list passes through sorted and trailing-LF
exact duplicate across inputs drops the repeat
case variants across inputs: first-added variant survives both keys
case-variant duplicate: the first-added case wins, order is sort order
reorder: output is sorted regardless of input order
interior empty line is an item, kept once
CRLF input parses to LF-joined output
whitespace-only line sorts before letters (CompareText byte order)
underscore sorts before folded letters (ASCII fold, byte order)
mixed-case duplicates inside a single input collapse
dual-write style merge: stored favorite list + new chapter links
long lists merge with case-variant overlap kept once
